name: Acquisition Level Intermixing
definition: A multi-volume rendering framework where multiple spatially aligned volumes (from 3D/3D registration) are combined into a single vectorial volume at the earliest stage (acquisition level), before the standard rendering pipeline, allowing statistical analysis on the combined data.
summary: Acquisition Level Intermixing fuses aligned scalar volumes into a vectorial volume for statistical classification before rendering, preserving depth ordering unlike accumulation-level methods.
